A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same HDyS research. Their complete text, equations, figures, tables and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original HDyS experiments on inverse dynamics, ground reaction forces, biomechanical simulation and character control, including appendix analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results and adds temporal-refinement and GroundLink representation ablations in its appendix.

M1.justification: Equation 3 revises the stated alignment objective from summed normalized similarities to their negative logarithms. This is a limited loss-formulation correction; the architecture remains unchanged. Both versions describe the loss as InfoNCE, and the PDFs do not establish an implementation change or retraining.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImDy, AddBiomechanics, MinT, MiA, AMASS and GroundLink for the same inverse-dynamics and downstream tasks. The added ablations introduce no new dataset, population or task coverage.

E2.justification: v2 adds HDyS without temporal refinement as a comparator in Table 9 and marker, SMPL and keypoint variants specifically for GroundLink in Table 10. Existing external-baseline comparisons, including ImDyS, MiA and GroundLinkNet, are retained.

E3.justification: The new appendix experiments introduce controls removing the temporal transformer and evaluating separate kinematic representations on GroundLink. Previously reported splits, metrics, training budgets and simulation settings are unchanged; the architecture-selection explanation does not establish revised settings.

E4.justification: Appendix B.2.2/Table 9 newly tests the contribution of temporal refinement, while B.3/Table 10 tests representation contributions to ground reaction force estimation. Existing dataset, component, dimensionality, scale-versus-heterogeneity and simulation-frame-rate analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. Both retain the same average/best reporting over predictions from different input representations.

E6.justification: v2 adds ablation results, including ImDy average/best mPJE of 0.7002/0.5334 without temporal refinement in Table 9 and GroundLink representation-specific errors in Table 10. Shared numerical results remain unchanged, including the simulation results moved from v1 Table 9 to v2 Table 11.

T1.justification: Equation 3 adds the missing negative logarithm, correcting the mathematical formulation of the described contrastive loss. Its revised summation subscript repeats z2 rather than naming z1 and z2, introducing a notation defect. Other mathematical definitions and equations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: identifying dynamics heterogeneity, constructing a homogeneous reusable space and demonstrating its usefulness. The new appendix evidence does not broaden or redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Appendix B.2.3 adds architectural rationale for using MLPs versus transformers and identifies autoregressive architectures as possible future work. The new ablations receive corresponding interpretations; existing limitations concerning lower-body bias, muscle prediction and simulation drift are retained.

D1.justification: Appendix B.2.3 newly documents architecture-selection criteria: dimensions and attention heads reflect input/output sizes, while transformer depth targets baseline parameter counts. Numerical architecture specifications, training hyperparameters, hardware and resource-access links remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations to HybrIK, HAKE and Interacted Object Grounding in Spatio-Temporal Human-Object Interactions, and removes SIFU. The dynamics literature review and overall positioning remain stable; several other references merely receive publication-metadata updates.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized grammatical edits, adds an affiliation and acknowledgements, and expands the appendix with new subsections and architectural explanation. The main narrative and section order remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds two appendix tables and adjusts table sizes, spacing and figure placement, notably Figures 4–7. Earlier appendix Tables 9–10 become Tables 11–12. All seven existing figures retain their substantive content.

improvement.justification: The added temporal-refinement and GroundLink ablations address specific gaps in v1's supporting evidence, while the architectural explanation improves assessability. Equation 3 gains the missing negative logarithm, although its revised summation introduces an index typo. These provide a limited net improvement around unchanged main results and claims.
